The '''''Ro-ti-Mundi''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that was in service with the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the later part of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. This vessel was part of the [[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle Fleet]] that participated in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="CL" />

==History==
''Ro-ti-Mundi'' served as a support carrier in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], and it was from this vessel that [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Davijaan/Legends|Davijaan]] launched [[Clone Flight Squad Seven/Legends|Squad Seven]] into combat over the Republic capital of Coruscant during the Battle of Coruscant.<ref name="CL" />
